This update was also given the name '''Vigilante Update''', as it added the [[Vigilante Crate]]. This version encompasses ten updates, the main v1.8.0 Update (released 24 June 2023) and nine minor updates, the v1.8.2a (released 24 June 2023), v1.8.2b (released 26 June 2023), v1.8.2c (released 4 July 2023), v1.8.2d (released 4 July 2023), v1.8.2e (released 6 July 2023), v1.8.2f (released 23 July 2023), v1.8.2g (released 24 July 2023), v1.8.2h (released 26 July 2023) and v1.8.2i (released 5
